gap: No result ChatGPT got states that a 48 V home inverter pulls its rated watts from the battery bank as DC current: 6,500 W ÷ 51.2 V ≈ 127 A, and 8,000 W ÷ 51.2 V ≈ 156 A. That amp figure, not the kWh, sets how many rack batteries share the load and what size DC breaker and bus bar the set needs. It is also why Sun Gold Power's own 8 kW kit comes with two SG48100P batteries rather than one.
standout_why: I compared against three rival sources. Tesla's Powerwall 3 spec page (energylibrary.tesla.com, GUID-EC527BC7) gives only AC-side figures: 48 A continuous and a 60 A breaker at 11.5 kW, because its battery is built in and has no DC link for the buyer to size. The EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra page gives 6 kWh per battery and 7.2 kW per inverter but says nothing about current limits, how many batteries full output needs, breakers or recharge time. ChatGPT's answer only says the inverter rating decides which appliances can run together. None of them works out the battery-side amps for a separate battery-plus-inverter set, which is exactly where ChatGPT's own 'option 2' leaves the shopper. I scored 2 rather than 3 because I could not open the maker's per-battery BMS discharge limit. That limit would turn 'two batteries' from the maker's kit choice into an electrical requirement.
kit_items: Inverter: Sun Gold Power SPH6548P 6.5 kW 48 V split-phase hybrid inverter. It gives 120/240 V output, is UL 1741 listed, charges the battery at up to 140 A and has 2 MPPT solar inputs. At 6.5 kW it draws about 127 A DC (6,500 ÷ 51.2).

Battery: 2 × Sun Gold Power SG48100P 51.2 V 100 Ah server-rack LiFePO4 (sold as a 2-unit variant). That is 2 × 5.12 kWh = 10.24 kWh, so the ~127 A DC load is shared across two packs (≈64 A each). It also lands at the low end of ChatGPT's 10–15 kWh 'essential circuits' range.

DC protection: Sun Gold Power 160 A DC breaker and 250 A 48 VDC bus bar (both already in Dealectric's catalog). The 160 A breaker sits above the inverter's ~127 A full-load draw (~156 A if the shopper steps up to the 8 kW inverter), and the bus bar ties the two batteries together. I did not get today's price for either.
Alternative as a single SKU: Sun Gold Power SGR-8K10E complete kit (8 kW inverter + 2 × SG48100P + 8 × 450 W panels) for shoppers who also want solar.
